channel_host_drain_proof_ref.description: Opaque, scoped reference to an immutable ChannelHostDrainProof row; not a ResourceRef or authority token.

channel_host_continuity_proof_ref.description: Opaque, scoped reference to an immutable ChannelHostContinuityProof row; not a ResourceRef or authority token.

relative_path.description: Slash-separated selected path; provenance/display metadata only, never a filesystem locator or grant.

source_release_basis.description: v2 provenance only for cross-Runtime ACTIVE reassignment. RuntimeMesh service validates source Runtime differs from target against the current assignment. SQL release_kind QUIESCENT maps to SAFE_SETTLEMENT_PROOF; EXPIRY_PLUS_SKEW maps to LEASE_EXPIRY_PLUS_SKEW.

source_drain_proof_ref.description: Opaque scoped reference to the immutable SQL ChannelHostDrainProof row; present with its digest only when the matching lease-release row has release_kind QUIESCENT.

source_drain_proof_digest.description: Digest of the referenced immutable source settlement proof.

continuity_proof_ref.description: Opaque scoped reference to the immutable continuity proof for a verified cross-Runtime ingress-continuous assignment.

continuity_proof_digest.description: Digest of the referenced immutable continuity proof row.

ingress_gap_decision.description: Authenticated owner decision and audit provenance for a newly accepted ingress gap. RuntimeMesh service validates every field against the referenced same-Workspace AuditRecord.
